lines: The meadow is quiet again. Someone has scratched a small star under the words.
The mosslings are gone from the meadow.
A pouch hangs from the post, left by whoever wrote the sign. Inside: 40 Glint.
Mosslings, shardstruck since the starfall, nest in the meadow east of the stones.
TO WHOEVER READS THIS: since the starfall the mosslings in the meadow have turned wild.
Drive them off and the stones will be safe to visit again. A reward hangs here for you.
